description: Find plants by name, common alias or plant ID across ten languages. Returns canonical plant IDs, category and care-page links. Cut flowers and rooted potted plants are separate entries. Use a returned plant_id with get_plant_care; if several plants fit, ask the user which one they have.

category.description: Optional category: cut = cut flowers; pot = flowering potted plants; leaf = foliage; succ = succulents.

language.description: Language of the returned guide. Use zh-Hans for Simplified Chinese; en for English. Plant-name search works across all languages.

query.description: A plant name, common alias or canonical ID, such as 绿萝, golden pothos or pothos. Search the plant name rather than a whole care question.

name: search_plants
title: Search flowers and plants
